# Organization Writing Standards for Requirements

## 1. INVEST Criteria
All User Stories must meet the INVEST criteria:
- **I**ndependent (can be finished in one sprint)
- **N**egotiable (open to discussion)
- **V**aluable (delivers value to the customer)
- **E**stimable (clear enough to size)
- **S**mall (fit in a sprint)
- **T**estable (has acceptance criteria)

## 2. Language & Tone
- **Active Voice**: Use "User clicks button" instead of "Button is clicked".
- **Clarity**: Avoid jargon unless it is a defined domain term.
- **Ambiguity**: Banned words: "fast", "user-friendly", "clean", "modern" (unless defined by a style guide or metric).

## 3. Acceptance Criteria Format
- MUST use Gherkin syntax (Given/When/Then).
- MUST cover at least one negative test case (failure scenario).

## 4. Formatting
- Use Markdown headers (#, ##).
- Use Checklists ([ ]) for tracking items.
